reads.note: Vermont Ave (50', 537-614, pipe line at ~565) meets Stock Ave (60', 6341 to ~6430, pipe line at ~6392) at Vermont's south end; Stock runs west, both end at the canal bed diagonal to the east, so it is an L-shaped corner. Point lies at/just past the canal-bed boundary diagonal; surrounding area masked white.

L-shaped junction: Vermont (50', x~537-613) comes from the north and Stock Ave (60', y~6340-6430) goes west; the SE side opens onto the old canal bed diagonal. Gamma line x~565 / y~6392 is the 6-inch water pipe. Point is the meeting of the two centrelines.
